title: Sources: the Pentagon is launching a task force to study how to safely deploy leading AI tools with hacking capabilities across Cyber Command and NSA missions (Politico)
summary: Politico: Sources: the Pentagon is launching a task force to study how to safely deploy leading AI tools with hacking capabilities across Cyber Command and NSA missions — These people, like others in this report, were granted anonymity because they were not authorized to speak publicly about the sensitive effort.
